Transportadora Gas del Norte SA Reports Steady Performance in Latest Results

Transportadora Gas del Norte SA, a leading player in Argentina’s Gas & Water Utilities industry, published its financial results this week, reflecting a stable performance amid evolving market conditions. The company reported steady revenues and operational efficiency for the first quarter of 2024, maintaining its role as a key provider in the national energy infrastructure.

According to the company’s statement, revenues for the quarter reached ARS 23.4 billion, marking a modest increase of 3.8% compared to the same period last year. Net income stood at ARS 4.1 billion, slightly above analysts’ expectations. The results were primarily attributed to effective cost management and consistent demand from industrial and residential clients across the provinces of Córdoba, Santa Fe, and Tucumán.

“Our focus remains on delivering reliable service and ensuring the safe transport of natural gas to millions of Argentines,” said Juan Pablo Ferraro, Chief Financial Officer of Transportadora Gas del Norte SA. “We have continued to invest in the maintenance and modernization of our pipeline network, which has contributed to our operational stability and efficiency.”

During a call with investors, Ferraro highlighted the company’s ongoing projects to improve compression stations and monitoring systems, underscoring a commitment to infrastructure resilience. “Upgrades in key sections of our network have reduced transmission losses and improved our capacity to respond to demand fluctuations,” he added.

Local analysts welcomed the results as a sign of stability in Argentina’s utilities sector, despite macroeconomic challenges. “Transportadora Gas del Norte SA’s performance is a positive indicator for the industry,” said María Gutiérrez, energy analyst at Consultora Litoral. “Their investments in technology and maintenance are paying off, and the company is well positioned to support Argentina’s energy transition goals.”

The Federación de Trabajadores del Gas expressed satisfaction with the company’s focus on safety and workforce development. “We value the ongoing training programs for pipeline technicians and the emphasis on occupational health,” said Ricardo Suárez, a union representative.

Looking ahead, company officials reaffirmed guidance for the year and noted that future investments would prioritize environmental sustainability and the integration of digital monitoring systems. “We are exploring further automation to optimize our operations while meeting Argentina’s regulatory standards,” said Ferraro.

Shares of Transportadora Gas del Norte SA closed up 1.2% on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange following the release of the results. The company’s next quarterly update is scheduled for August.
